Publish approved full-frame Luoyang homepage v12

Use the exact user-selected city-and-river painting, preserve its complete frame on desktop, tablet and mobile, and keep the former 07/v11 assets and entry pages archived. Add direct road and water evidence links without changing historical research data.

run.display_title: Merge PR #74: adopt approved full-frame homepage v12

head_commit.message:
Merge PR #74: adopt approved full-frame homepage v12

Use the exact full-frame city-and-river painting approved by the user on 2026-11-21. Preserve the complete image at all viewports, place text below the panorama, retain v11/07 history and all research baselines. PR run 44903475054 passed; 218 research tests, 6 homepage tests, and eight two-entry browser layouts verified. Production acceptance follows the automatic Pages workflow.
